evidence_corrupt.template: Snapshot evidence failed its integrity check: {detail}.

evidence_blocked.template: The snapshot carries an evidence block: {detail}.

scoring_format_unsupported.template: Scoring format {value} is not supported; the lab compares PPR projections only.

mixed_periods.template: Alternatives come from different periods ({detail}); one decision covers one season and week.

mixed_model_versions.template: Alternatives come from different model versions or candidates ({detail}); competing models are not extra players.

choice_set_too_large.template: {count} alternatives were nominated; the maximum is {limit}.

duplicate_alternative.template: Player {player_id} was nominated more than once.

excluded_unavailable.template: {player} excluded: marked unavailable for this slot.

excluded_slot_ineligible.template: {player} excluded: position {position} cannot fill the {slot} slot.

projection_missing.template: {players} have no finite PPR projection, so the comparison is incomplete.

availability_unresolved.template: Availability is not verified for {players}; record an explicit assumption before the comparison can proceed.

insufficient_choice_set.template: Only {count} comparable alternative(s) remain; a comparison needs at least {minimum}.

baseline_unavailable.template: No independent baseline for {players}; the policy requires one unless model-only exploration is enabled.

projection_tie.template: The leading projections tie at {value}; the order shown is by player id only, not evidence.

gap_below_minimum.template: The projection gap {gap} between {first} and {second} is below the minimum {threshold}.

floor_missing.template: {player} leads on projection but has no model floor while a floor guardrail of {threshold} is enabled.

floor_below_minimum.template: {player} leads on projection but its model floor {floor} is below the guardrail {threshold}.

recommend_highest_projection.template: {player} has the highest PPR projection ({value}), {gap} ahead of {second}, conditional on the recorded eligibility assumptions.

gap_meets_minimum.template: The projection gap {gap} meets the minimum {threshold}.

floor_meets_minimum.template: The leading floor {floor} meets the guardrail {threshold}.

baseline_agrees.template: The causal trailing-mean baseline also prefers {player} ({value}).

baseline_disagrees.template: The causal trailing-mean baseline prefers {player} ({value}) instead; the baseline is a separate comparator, not the model.

baseline_tie.template: The baseline values tie between {players}; it expresses no preference.

baseline_not_independent.template: Model-only exploration: no independent baseline for {players}; nothing here is a baseline comparison.

limitations.availability_user_assumed: Availability of the alternatives is user-assumed, not independently verified (no game-lock, injury, or roster feed).
limitations.population_hindsight_conditioned: Historical rows exist only for players who appear in realized stats; this is not a reconstructed pregame roster universe.
limitations.baseline_not_independent: The baseline comparator is not independent of the model for at least one alternative.
limitations.baseline_unreconciled: The baseline values for this snapshot have not been reconciled to an evaluation artifact.
limitations.floors_not_probabilities: Floors and ceilings are position-level residual quantiles added to the projection (floor clipped at zero); they are not individualized probabilities or guaranteed bounds.
limitations.snapshot_not_game_day_verified: A published weekly snapshot is a dated projection artifact; it is not current, live, or game-day verified.
limitations.synthetic_evidence: Synthetic inputs are for boundary and regression checks only; they are never historical evidence.
limitations.outcomes_inspectable: Outcome files are static public artifacts; the reveal sequence is educational, not secure blinding.
